name: pysms_contains_cliques_clique_size4_num_cliques2_vertices15__v2
prompt:
Generate a graph with 15 vertices that consists of exactly 2 vertex-disjoint clique(s), each of size 4. Every vertex must belong to one of these cliques, and the only edges in the graph are those within these cliques.

Return the graph as a list of edges (u, v) with 0 <= u < v < 15, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no graph exists.
